name: phaserjs/phaser
description: Phaser is a fun, free, and fast 2D game framework for making HTML5 games for desktop and mobile web browsers, supporting Canvas and WebGL rendering. The most popular dedicated HTML5 game framework.
score_rationale: 39.2k stars, the de-facto standard for HTML5 2D game development with 10+ years of active development, vast community, and extensive plugin library.
summary: Industry-standard HTML5 2D game framework with 39k stars and decade of active development

name: BabylonJS/Babylon.js
description: Babylon.js is a powerful, beautiful, simple, and open 3D game and rendering engine for the web, packed into a friendly TypeScript framework. Supports WebGL, WebGPU, and WebXR.
score_rationale: 25.3k stars, leading web 3D game engine with Microsoft heritage, active development, WebGPU support, and comprehensive tooling ecosystem.
summary: Leading web 3D engine with Microsoft backing, WebGPU/WebXR support, 25k stars

name: playcanvas/engine
description: PlayCanvas is a powerful web graphics runtime built on WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR, and glTF, used as the rendering engine behind the PlayCanvas cloud-hosted game editor.
score_rationale: 14.6k stars, production-grade web 3D engine supporting WebGPU and WebXR with active March 2026 releases backing a professional cloud game platform.
summary: Production-grade 3D engine powering PlayCanvas cloud editor with 14.6k stars

name: increpare/PuzzleScript
description: An open-source HTML5 puzzle game engine with a simple domain-specific language for creating and sharing grid-based puzzle games entirely in the browser.
score_rationale: 1k stars, a beloved niche engine with a dedicated community for creating and sharing grid puzzle games, widely used in game jams.
summary: Beloved niche DSL for grid-based puzzle games with dedicated game jam community

name: replit/kaboom
description: Kaboom.js was a JavaScript game library for making fun 2D web games, now archived and superseded by the community fork KaPlay.
score_rationale: 2.7k stars but archived November 2024 by Replit — historically relevant as the predecessor of the active KaPlay fork.
summary: Archived 2D game library now superseded by KaPlay community fork

name: mrdrbob/2b2d
description: A simple 2D from-scratch WebGPU/TypeScript game engine inspired by Bevy with ECS architecture, zero dependencies, and LDtk/Aseprite integration.
score_rationale: Only 23 stars, very early-stage experimental WebGPU engine with minimal community traction, though technically interesting as a Bevy-inspired web ECS engine.
summary: Early-stage WebGPU engine with Bevy-inspired ECS and zero dependencies
